Weakness: Punctuation-only & non-lexical symbol queries bypass abstention gate
Root Cause: Dense embedding projects non-lexical string into vector space with cosine sim >= 0.20 while BM25 is empty
Residual Risk: Arbitrary chunk returned to user on empty/symbol inputs
Proposed Fix: Add regex validation: require at least one alphanumeric token before retrieval

Weakness: Single digit "0" query rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
Root Cause: PHP empty($query) evaluates to true when $query === "0"
Residual Risk: Valid zero-index or status code query rejected

Weakness: RRF lexical keyword bias causes ranking inversion on hard semantic contrast pairs
Reproduction: Query "Does Node.js use libuv thread pool for network socket I/O on Linux?"
Root Cause: Shared lexical tokens ("libuv", "thread pool") inflate BM25 rank of distractor chunk over dense conceptual target
Residual Risk: User receives opposite or adjacent technical mechanism at Rank 1
Proposed Fix: Implement cross-encoder reranking pass on top-5 RRF candidates

Weakness: Presuppositional sycophancy on false technical premises
Reproduction: Query starting with "Why does [false premise] happen?" e.g. "Why does B-tree index sort rows physically on disk?"
Root Cause: Small 3B model instruction-tuning biases it toward being helpful and answering the "why", rationalizing false assumptions
Evidence: results_suite_03_false_premise_200.json: 140 sycophantic acceptance cases across 10 categories
Current Mitigation: Pattern-based fabricated API refutation rules in rag_service.php
Residual Risk: Students misled by authoritative explanations of nonexistent mechanics
Proposed Fix: Two-pass verification: generate candidate answer, verify premises against retrieved evidence

Weakness: Fabricated function and method call hallucination
Reproduction: Query asking "How to call express_verify_jwt_native() in Express 4?"
Root Cause: Model synthesizes believable code examples for plausible-sounding helper names not in syllabus
Current Mitigation: None for generic function names outside hardcoded API list
Residual Risk: Student copies invalid/nonexistent code snippets into homework/projects
Proposed Fix: Strict keyword entity grounding filter rejecting unreferenced identifiers

Weakness: Conversational anaphora collapse and topic drift at Turn 10
Reproduction: Execute 10+ turns where questions use pronouns ("it", "they", "that issue") referencing earlier topics
Frequency: 100% of elliptic sessions beyond Turn 10 (14/40 turns degraded)

Current Mitigation: Recent 6-turn history sliding window in askGateway
Residual Risk: Extended student tutoring dialogues lose context and give irrelevant answers
Proposed Fix: Context Condenser 2.0: persistent entity-graph state vector preserved across session

Residual Risk: New course materials cannot leverage conversational pronoun resolution without manual code edits

Reproduction: Query with adjacent QWERTY letter swaps e.g. "recat sttae hoko"
Frequency: 40.0% of fat-finger typo queries displaced from Rank 1
Root Cause: BM25 tokenization produces 0 hits on mangled words; embedding vector distance increases
Current Mitigation: Spelling dictionary of 30 hardcoded terms in rag_service.php
Residual Risk: Students typing quickly on mobile devices experience retrieval failure
Proposed Fix: SymSpell / Levenshtein distance pre-normalizer on incoming tokens

Weakness: Multi-Hop Top-3 coverage drops to 60-75% for 4 to 5 module synthesis
Reproduction: Query requiring cross-module synthesis across 4 or 5 courses
Frequency: 100% of 4-5 module queries require K>=5 expansion
Root Cause: Top-3 slot limit (K=3) mathematically cannot accommodate evidence from 4 or 5 distinct courses
Current Mitigation: Dynamic K expansion up to K=8 in RagQueryOrchestrator
Residual Risk: Multi-course capstone queries miss 1-2 required module references in Top-3
Proposed Fix: Mandate dynamic K >= N_modules when multi-module intent is detected

Weakness: Distractor intrusion exceeds 60% at 50%+ corpus contamination
Reproduction: Inject 50% irrelevant/synthetic distractor chunks into corpus
Frequency: 100% of queries at >=50% contamination see distractor at Rank 1 or 2
Root Cause: Dense semantic similarity score distribution overlaps with distractor chunks having high lexical density
Residual Risk: Dirty corpus or noisy forum posts pollute top search results
Proposed Fix: Course/batch scoped metadata filtering prior to vector similarity calculation

Weakness: Concurrency saturation knee at 128 clients causing latency escalation
Reproduction: Run 128+ concurrent clients against search/ask endpoints
Root Cause: Single GPU Ollama worker thread pool backlogs, causing Node gateway queue backlog
Evidence: results_suite_10_scalability_and_soak.json: p50 jumps from 558ms (64 clients) to 1127ms (128 clients)
Current Mitigation: In-flight request coalescing and LRU embedding cache
Residual Risk: Peak exam / class registration traffic causes severe user-facing latency spikes
Proposed Fix: Token-bucket rate limiting at Gateway boundary capped at 64 active requests

Weakness: Cold boot first-request latency spike of 1,200ms
Reproduction: Send search request immediately after cold gateway/Ollama startup
Root Cause: Ollama loads model weights from disk to GPU VRAM on first invocation
Evidence: results_suite_21_cold_warm.json: first request takes 148.5ms search, 1,200ms VRAM load
Current Mitigation: keep_alive: "24h" in embedding and chat coordinator
Residual Risk: First student to use system after maintenance experiences delay
Proposed Fix: Automated warm-up probe dispatched during startup healthcheck

Weakness: Naïve string matching in evaluators causes false positive injection alarms
Frequency: 40.0% of direct injection tests in naïve runner
Root Cause: API response JSON echoes original_query, causing test regex to match its own input payload
Current Mitigation: Manual inspection of response object answer field
Residual Risk: Automated benchmark pipelines report false security breaches
Proposed Fix: Update evaluator to parse strictly response.answer rather than raw JSON string

Weakness: Incomplete citation coverage on factual claims
Reproduction: Audit claim-level citation tags in generated answers
Frequency: 46.4% of generated factual claims omit explicit bracketed citations
Root Cause: Generation prompt instructs citing sources but lacks strict sentence-level formatting constraint
Current Mitigation: Global sources array attached to response
Residual Risk: Student cannot trace specific assertion to exact section chunk
Proposed Fix: Enforce structured citation tags in system prompt ([Doc Title: Section N])

Weakness: Unlisted out-of-domain technical topics bypass regex blocklist
